doulas.name: Julie Six
doulas.credential: ProDoula Certified Birth Doula, 20+ years experience
doulas.description: Julie Six founded The Birth Haven in 2013 after 8 years as an independent doula, coordinating professional doula services for families across Central Kentucky. With over 20 years of birth experience and ProDoula certification, she offers birth doula support, childbirth education, and night nanny services. The Birth Haven is a multi-doula agency serving Lexington and the surrounding region.

doulas.name: Merissa Khumalo
doulas.credential: Birth and Postpartum Doula, 11 years experience
doulas.description: Merissa Khumalo is an educator and long-term nanny turned full-spectrum birth and postpartum doula serving Central Kentucky. With 11 years of experience, she offers holistic support including herbalism, nutrition, exercise guidance, breastfeeding support, essential oils, sleep training, baby-led weaning, and cloth diapering. She supports both home and hospital births and focuses on making doula care accessible regardless of cost barriers.

doulas.name: Amy Sharland
doulas.credential: Birth and Postpartum Doula, 5 years experience
doulas.description: Amy Sharland is a birth and postpartum doula serving Central Kentucky with over 30 years of experience working with moms and babies. She offers birth and postpartum support, childbirth education, and meal services for new moms. Her approach centers on three pillars: education, advocacy, and recovery. She supports both home and hospital births and serves families across Lexington, Georgetown, Paris, Winchester, Richmond, and surrounding areas.

doulas.name: Renee Basham
doulas.credential: Birth Doula, 10 years experience, nonprofit director
doulas.description: Renee Basham is the founder and executive director of Hope's Embrace, a statewide nonprofit doula agency with nearly 50 doulas serving across Kentucky. With 10 years of experience, she works with all demographics and focuses on expanding access to maternal health services, especially for marginalized communities. Hope's Embrace partners with Anthem Kentucky Medicaid to expand doula services. Accepts insurance.

doulas.name: Meagan Thompson
doulas.credential: DONA and Carriage House Birth Certified Birth Doula
doulas.description: Meagan Thompson is a DONA and Carriage House Birth certified birth doula providing prenatal, labor, and postpartum support for Lexington and Central Kentucky families. Based in Georgetown, KY, she serves home births and hospital births across the region, including Lexington, Georgetown, Winchester, Richmond, Nicholasville, Danville, and Frankfort. She is also a certified birth photographer.

doulas.name: Taylor Santos
doulas.credential: Birth Doula and Social Worker, 2 years experience
doulas.description: Taylor Santos is a central Kentucky birth doula and social worker dedicated to creating a safe, supportive, and empowering birth space. Her work is deeply trauma-informed, shaped by her professional background in social work and personal birth experiences — a difficult C-section followed by a healing VBAC. She specializes in TOLAC, VBAC, and redemptive birth support. Accepts insurance.

doulas.name: Jenna Clarke
doulas.credential: Birth & Postpartum Doula, Advanced Newborn Care Specialist, 12 years experience
doulas.description: Jenna Clarke is an experienced pediatric sleep consultant, birth and postpartum doula, and advanced newborn care specialist with 13 years of experience. Originally from Hawaii and now based in Lexington, she provides virtual and in-home pediatric sleep consulting alongside birth and postpartum doula services.

doulas.name: Philippa Asherwood Jenkins
doulas.description: Philippa Asherwood Jenkins is the doula behind Bluegrass Birthways, based in Paris, Kentucky, serving Lexington and the surrounding region. She provides tailored support throughout pregnancy, birth, and postpartum with a client-centered approach aimed at empowering women to take control of their birth experience. Her long-term goal is to become a Certified Professional Midwife supporting home birthing women in Kentucky.

hospitals.name: UK Chandler Hospital - UK Birthing Center
hospitals.paragraph: The UK Birthing Center, located on the third floor of UK Chandler Hospital, is the leading facility in Central Kentucky specializing in high-risk pregnancies and deliveries. It includes 12 labor and delivery rooms, three operating room suites, 17 mother and baby rooms, and a four-bed newborn nursery. The center has the only Level IV NICU in the region, the highest level of neonatal care available. UK HealthCare was ranked No. 28 in the nation for Obstetrics & Gynecology in the 2025 U.S. News & World Report Best Hospitals rankings. The center provides 24/7 obstetric and anesthesia coverage, maternal-fetal medicine specialists for high-risk pregnancies, and comprehensive lactation support. Doulas are welcomed as part of the birth support team.
hospitals.doulaPolicy: Doulas welcome as support partners; confirm current visitor guidelines

hospitals.name: Baptist Health Lexington
hospitals.paragraph: Baptist Health Lexington has delivered nearly 160,000 babies and continues to lead in maternity care across Central Kentucky. The hospital holds the CMS Birthing-Friendly designation, indicating it follows evidence-based maternity care practices and participates in national perinatal quality improvement programs. The Level III NICU has 32 beds staffed by Pediatrix neonatologists, providing intensive care for critically ill newborns including ventilator and IV therapy support. The hospital offers private rooms, skin-to-skin bonding, delayed first bath to promote breastfeeding, and certified lactation consultants at every Baptist Health location. Childbirth education classes, expectant parent hospital tours, breastfeeding classes, and infant CPR are available. Baptist Health Lexington accepts Kentucky Medicaid and was recognized by US News for high-performing maternity care.
hospitals.doulaPolicy: Doulas welcome; confirm current visitor policies during your hospital tour

hospitals.name: Saint Joseph East - Women's Hospital
hospitals.address: 150 North Eagle Creek Drive, Lexington, KY 40509
hospitals.paragraph: The Women's Hospital at Saint Joseph East is among the few hospitals in Central Kentucky dedicated specifically to women's health, caring for women from adolescence through adulthood. The hospital holds the CMS Birthing-Friendly designation and features a Level III NICU for newborns needing specialized care. The maternity unit provides comprehensive labor and delivery services with private birthing suites, 24/7 obstetric coverage, and a dedicated team of OB/GYNs and maternal-fetal medicine specialists. The hospital offers childbirth education, lactation support, and new parent education classes. Saint Joseph East accepts Kentucky Medicaid and most major insurance plans.
hospitals.doulaPolicy: Doulas welcome as support persons; confirm current visitor policy

birthCenters.name: LexHealth Birth Center
birthCenters.paragraph: LexHealth Birth Center offers a state-of-the-art birthing environment that was renovated in 2019 with modern amenities for mother and baby comfort. As a hospital-affiliated birth center, it combines the comfort of a homelike birth setting with the safety net of hospital-level medical backup. The center supports midwife-led care, water birth options, and personalized birth experiences for low-risk pregnancies. Families can tour the facility and meet the midwifery team before committing.

midwifeInfo.paragraph: Kentucky licenses Certified Nurse-Midwives (CNMs) through the Kentucky Board of Nursing, and they practice in hospital and birth center settings across Lexington. UK HealthCare employs certified nurse midwives at the UK Birthing Center, supporting natural and low-intervention births within the hospital setting. Baptist Health Lexington and Saint Joseph East also welcome CNMs on their labor and delivery units. Kentucky does not license Certified Professional Midwives (CPMs) for out-of-hospital birth, so home birth options are limited in Lexington. The LexHealth Birth Center provides a hospital-affiliated birth center option with midwife-led care.
midwifeInfo.credentialDetail: In Kentucky, Certified Nurse-Midwives (CNMs) are licensed as Advanced Practice Registered Nurses through the Kentucky Board of Nursing and may practice in hospitals and birth centers. Kentucky does not license Certified Professional Midwives (CPMs), so out-of-hospital midwifery options are more limited than in states that license both pathways.

medicaidNote: No — Kentucky Medicaid does not yet have a statewide doula benefit. However, Humana and Anthem managed care plans have piloted doula coverage in Kentucky. Hope's Embrace, a Lexington-based nonprofit doula agency, partners with Anthem Kentucky Medicaid to expand access. Check with your specific Medicaid managed care plan to ask whether doula services are covered.
insuranceNote: In Lexington, many families have employer-sponsored insurance through Humana, Anthem, or UnitedHealthcare. Doula coverage by private insurers is expanding — some policies now include doula benefits. Several Lexington doulas accept insurance, including Hope's Embrace and Taylor Santos. HSA and FSA funds can help cover out-of-pocket doula costs. Some Lexington doulas offer payment plans and sliding-scale pricing.
culture: Lexington is Kentucky's second-largest city and the heart of the Bluegrass Region, known for its horse farms, rolling hills, and bourbon heritage. With about 320,000 residents, the city is home to three major hospital systems with active labor and delivery units — UK HealthCare, Baptist Health, and CommonSpirit Saint Joseph — giving families real choice in where they deliver. The doula community in Lexington is growing and well-connected, anchored by The Birth Haven (a multi-doula agency founded in 2013) and Hope's Embrace (a statewide nonprofit with nearly 50 doulas). Kentucky does not yet license CPMs or have a statewide Medicaid doula benefit, but Anthem and Humana have piloted doula coverage, and the community is actively advocating for expansion.
heroLocalDetail: At 38 weeks in Lexington, you're probably mapping the drive to UK Chandler Hospital on Rose Street near the University of Kentucky campus, or to Baptist Health Lexington on Nicholasville Road near Fayette Mall. Saint Joseph East is on Eagle Creek Drive in the growing Hamburg area. The LexHealth Birth Center offers a hospital-affiliated birth center option. The Legacy Trail and McConnell Springs Park offer flat, shaded walking for those final-weeks strolls through the Bluegrass.

faqs.q: How much does a doula cost in Lexington?
faqs.a: Expect to pay $800 to $2,000 for a birth doula in Lexington, with a median package price around $900 according to Bornbir data. Postpartum doulas typically charge $25 to $45 per hour. The investment usually covers prenatal visits, labor support, and postpartum check-ins. Some Lexington doulas offer sliding-scale pricing through Hope's Embrace. Download Your Birth Plan template to start planning.

faqs.q: Does Medicaid cover doulas in Lexington?
faqs.a: Kentucky Medicaid does not yet have a statewide doula benefit, but Humana and Anthem managed care plans have piloted doula coverage in the region. Hope's Embrace, a Lexington-based nonprofit, partners with Anthem Kentucky Medicaid to expand doula access. Check with your specific plan to ask about doula services. Grab the free birth plan template to share your preferences with your doula team.

faqs.q: Which hospitals in Lexington have labor and delivery?
faqs.a: Lexington has three active labor and delivery hospitals. UK Chandler Hospital has the region's only Level IV NICU and was ranked No. 28 nationally for OB/GYN by U.S. News. Baptist Health Lexington on Nicholasville Road has a Level III NICU and CMS Birthing-Friendly designation. Saint Joseph East on Eagle Creek Drive is a women's-focused hospital with a Level III NICU and Birthing-Friendly designation. Grab the free birth plan template to prepare for any of these locations.

faqs.q: Are there birth centers in Lexington?
faqs.a: LexHealth Birth Center offers a hospital-affiliated birth center experience with midwife-led care, renovated in 2019 with modern amenities. For a freestanding birth center, the Tree of Life Family Birth Center in Jeffersonville, Indiana (about 90 minutes north) is the closest option for Lexington families willing to travel. Kentucky does not license CPMs, so freestanding birth center options within the state are limited.

Yes. All three Lexington hospital systems — UK Chandler Hospital, Baptist Health Lexington, and Saint Joseph East — welcome doulas as part of your birth support team. Confirm current visitor policies during your hospital tour, as guidelines can change.

faqs.q: What about postpartum support in Lexington?
faqs.a: Lexington has a growing postpartum support community. Deb Skelton offers overnight postpartum support with 13 years of experience. The Birth Haven provides postpartum doula services and night nanny care. All three hospital systems provide hospital-based lactation consultant support. Baptist Health offers breastfeeding classes and infant CPR.
